fields.hook: You do not need a code for this wallet. It is $95, and you can start a return within 99 days of the order.
fields.body: Start a return within 99 days of the order; it must be in usable condition. Not eligible for returns: personalized items, warranty claim orders and certain limited edition items. Defective parts free. Lost: $17.95 replacement fee today, up to twice. Claims are reviewed and can be denied; Ridge may ask for proof of purchase and photos. Terms as of 23 October 2026; they can change.
